hook: Let AI coding agents loose, safely, in a VM.
hookText: Hangar: coding agents in disposable VMs

beats.say: Hangar is a free, open-source Mac app and CLI that runs Claude Code and Codex inside a macOS, Linux or Windows virtual machine.
With approvals off, agents can't touch your Mac's files, your SSH or cloud keys. They see only the folder you share and reach only the sites you allow.
And if one breaks something, one command undoes everything it did. Install it with Homebrew.
